issues.legal_issue: A specified landlord is not entitled to eviction for personal use merely because premises in a residential house are sought for professional chambers when the tenancy was created for clinic use and no change of use occurred.
material_facts: The landlord sought eviction under Section 13A to use the premises for chambers for legal practice after retiring from government service.
The premises were part of a residential house.
The tenancy had been created for locating a clinic.
The Rent Controller’s eviction order was set aside by the High Court, which dismissed the eviction application.
The Rent Controller reported that no sanctioned scheme of the kind referred to by the Court was operative in the city.
issues.conclusion: The landlord was not entitled to evict the tenant, and the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 13A of the East Punjab Urban Rent Restriction Act, the landlord’s asserted need for personal use did not entitle him to eviction on these facts. The Court found no change of use because the tenancy was created to locate a clinic, distinguishing the case from the precedents concerning a change of use. The judgment does not name those precedents or state any further statutory test.

rule.if: specified_landlord_eviction_appeal and landlord_sought_chambers_for_own_practice and premises_part_of_residential_house and tenancy_created_for_clinic_use

predicates.specified_landlord_eviction_appeal: A specified landlord appeals after a court has refused the landlord’s eviction request.
predicates.landlord_sought_chambers_for_own_practic: The landlord sought to use the premises as chambers for the landlord’s own professional practice.
predicates.premises_part_of_residential_house: The premises formed part of a residential house.
predicates.tenancy_created_for_clinic_use: The premises were leased from the outset for use as a clinic.

issues.definition: When a specified landlord appeals after refusal of eviction, and the landlord seeks professional chambers in part of a residential house that was leased from the outset for clinic use, the personal-use eviction request is denied.
